title: Zebra holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="bodyClip">
      <ellipse cx="45" cy="62" rx="24" ry="17"/>

  </defs>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d="M62 40 Q66 46 63 52 Q61 56 64 58" stroke="#e8e8ff" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none"/>

  <rect x="28" y="74" width="6" height="18" rx="2" fill="#f2f2f8"/>

  <rect x="52" y="74" width="6" height="18" rx="2" fill="#f2f2f8"/>

  <rect x="39" y="89" width="8" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#3a3a66"/>

    <rect x="33" y="46" width="6" height="34" fill="#5a5a92"/>
    <rect x="45" y="46" width="6" height="34" fill="#5a5a92"/>
    <rect x="57" y="46" width="6" height="34" fill="#5a5a92"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M21 58 Q14 56 13 50" stroke="#5a5a92" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <path d="M60 52 L68 36 L76 38 L70 56 Z" fill="#f2f2f8"/>
  <path d="M62 50 L69 37 L72 38 L66 52 Z" fill="#5a5a92"/>
  <path d="M67 40 L73 39 L72 44 L67 45 Z" fill="#5a5a92"/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d="M64 34 L62 28 L68 30 L67 24 L73 27 L73 33 Z" fill="#5a5a92"/>

  <ellipse cx="78" cy="34" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#f2f2f8" transform="rotate(15 78 34)"/>

  <ellipse cx="89" cy="38" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#dcdcf0"/>
  <ellipse cx="92" cy="36" rx="1.6" ry="1.6" fill="#3a3a66"/>

  <path d="M86 41 Q89 43 92 41" stroke="#5a5a92" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="81" cy="31" r="2.6" fill="#3a3a66"/>
  <circle cx="81.8" cy="30.2" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="24" rx="2.6" ry="5" fill="#f2f2f8" transform="rotate(-25 72 24)"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="24" rx="1.3" ry="3" fill="#5a5a92" transform="rotate(-25 72 24)"/>
  <!-- Hoof holding string -->
  <circle cx="63" cy="56" r="3" fill="#3a3a66"/>
